text: {"decision": "reject", "reason": "home_player_X9 is a field-position coordinate (values 1–9 for the 9th home player's X location, matching the pattern of home_player_X1..X11 and Y columns), so its overlap with Player.id is coincidental small-integer chance (coverage 0.001), while the true player references are home_player_1..11 which map to player_api_id."}
